disagreement_analysis: The disagreement between 'safe' and 'inconclusive' was caused by tool errors (an HTTP 400 API error and a safety filter parsing failure) when auditing the .gitignore file in two of the models, rather than any actual security concerns or code injection.

learnings: The orchestrator should not force an 'inconclusive' package verdict if a tool error occurs on a non-executable, benign file like .gitignore, especially when other models have successfully audited it.
